fish.fun_fact: Its enormous hinged jaw can open wide enough to swallow prey larger than its own body, a useful adaptation when food is scarce.
fish.name: Pelican Eel

fish.description: An aggressive predator and one of the most sought sport fish.
fish.fun_fact: Can see colour and uses it to identify and target specific prey.
fish.name: Largemouth Bass

fish.fun_fact: Electric Eels generate shocks of up to 860 volts, enough to stun a horse, and use weaker pulses to navigate and locate prey in complete darkness.
fish.name: Electric Eel

fish.description: One of the most aggressive sharks, equally comfortable in salt and freshwater.
fish.fun_fact: Bull sharks have been found over 4,000 km up the Amazon River, far from the open ocean.
fish.name: Bull Shark

fish.fun_fact: Its enormous hinged jaw can open wide enough to swallow prey larger than its own body, a useful adaptation when food is scarce.
fish.name: Pelican Eel

fish.description: A blind hydrothermal-vent crab with hair-covered claws.
fish.fun_fact: Found only at hydrothermal vents. The hairy claws farm bacteria they eat.
fish.name: Yeti Crab

fish.description: A long, predatory deep-sea fish with light-producing barbels.
fish.fun_fact: Lures prey with a glowing barbel. Its teeth are transparent so the lure isn't blocked.
fish.name: Black Dragonfish

fish.description: A small, colorful sunfish common in lakes and ponds.
fish.fun_fact: Can make grunting sounds by grinding their teeth together.
fish.name: Bluegill

fish.fun_fact: Needlefish can leap from water at speeds up to 37 mph and have accidentally impaled fishermen with their needle-like beaks, making them unexpectedly dangerous for such a small fish.
fish.name: Needlefish

fish.description: A ferocious pack hunter known for its slashing, violent strikes.
fish.fun_fact: Will enter a feeding frenzy and continue attacking fish even when completely full, leaving trails of destruction.
fish.name: Bluefish

fish.description: A fast, schooling fish with striking iridescent markings.
fish.fun_fact: Cannot stop swimming or they will suffocate, since they breathe only by moving forward through the water.
fish.name: Atlantic Mackerel

fish.description: A tiny, nearly transparent fish found in staggering numbers throughout the deep ocean.
fish.fun_fact: Bristlemouths may be the most abundant vertebrate on the entire planet, with billions inhabiting the world's deep waters.
fish.name: Bristlemouth

fish.description: A small squid blanketed in photophores that pulse with vivid blue bioluminescent light.
fish.fun_fact: Firefly squid have three types of photoreceptors, one of which may let them perceive colour, a rare ability among cephalopods.
fish.name: Firefly Squid

note.title: Scratched into the post itself
note.body:
We put in here to wait out the dark and the dark did not end. Counted eleven turns of it. On the ninth the youngest asked whether we had sailed past the morning and none of us had an answer worth giving her.

We are going on. The hold is empty and going back is further than going on.

note.title: A bundle of pages, tied with line
note.body:
The Farthing went down four lengths off this rock in water so still you could read by it. No squall. No reason. She simply stopped being a boat.

We pulled six of her crew out and left with them. If you are anchored here reading this, do not anchor here.

note.title: One line, cut deep
note.body:
We were nineteen days past the last rock anybody had named and we named this one anyway, because a thing with a name is a thing you can come back to.

We did not come back to it. Somebody should.

Cobia, if you are offering. They hang about wreckage, so I see more of them than most, and I have never once got tired of it.

result.error: You have not landed a Cobia since they asked. One out of the hold does not count.

result.line: I have come up empty from better water than that. Do not repeat that anywhere.

result.error: Cass has not asked you for anything.

result.line: Yoon changed his mind again about that message. I have stopped waiting. You should too, probably.
A cod. Plain Atlantic cod. Everything else out here is somebody's trophy and a cod is just supper, which is the entire point of it.

result.error: You have not landed a Atlantic Cod since they asked. One out of the hold does not count.

result.line: You remembered. I mentioned this once, months ago, and you remembered.

result.error: Rue has not asked you for anything.

result.line: When you first came out here you counted the coin twice. You have not counted it in front of me for a year.
I catch myself doing the math on the Catfish Jackpot at, like, three in the morning. Bruh. If you ever see my boat by the Den after dark, come get me. I'm serious. It's rigged but I'll still play it.
When I stop being out here, and there will be a day, take the wreck at the eastern edge. I have left something in it that is yours.
If I am ever not here, do not look for me. Go up and stay up. That is the only favor I will ever ask.
You have started saying come up to other captains. It came back to me last week from somebody who has never met me.
The rod's just a rod now, isn't it. Told you. Nobody believes that part until after.
The thing for the new captains is happening. Slowly. Design docs are long. Mine's longer.
You never did ask what I found. I have got so used to that I would be thrown if you did.
Nothing to carry today. I sailed out here anyway. Work that one out, because I have not.
There is a mug on this boat that is yours. I did not decide that. It simply happened and now it is a rule.

result.error: You have already had a word with Meg Corrin today.

result.line: Did you see the price of the Shallow fishes this week? I shoulda held.

result.error: You have already had a word with Matty today.

result.line: You have started sounding like somebody who lives out here. I am not sure that is a kindness.

result.error: You have already had a word with Old Marlow today.

result.line: Mm. Yes. That was the whole thought and I stand by it.

result.error: You have already had a word with Quiet Fitch today.

result.line: The count is at four hundred and nine. Yours is still the number I check first.

result.error: You have already had a word with Grey Nance today.

result.line: Everything's gucci. Genuinely. I've got nothing left to teach you and I'm not even annoyed about it.

result.error: You have already had a word with Yoon today.

result.line: The boat's still ugly. The engine's new. Nobody's noticed. You will. You notice things.

result.error: You have already had a word with Dennis today.

result.line: I opened the door. Two summers ago. I am not going to tell you what was behind it, but I will tell you I closed it again.

result.error: You have already had a word with Cass Turbot today.

result.line: You are the first in forty years to ask what the news costs me. A sail and a bad back, since you keep asking.

result.error: You have already had a word with Rue Bream today.

result.line: I have started weighing yours last. It is the only part of the day I am in no hurry for.
Feels good to be making some gains.
Forty years of this and the sea still does something new every month. Stay long enough and it will show you.
I would tell you now. You still have not asked. I have decided that is the point.
You have started saying come up to other captains. It came back to me last week from somebody who has never met me.
Everything's gucci out here when you're fishing like this. Gyattt. Don't tell the harbor I said gucci.

The money's going somewhere, by the way. It's not going in a bigger boat. It's going into something for people who are where I was two seasons ago. Don't ask me what yet. I'm still writing the design doc.
You are the only captain who has never asked me what I have found. That is exactly why I would tell you.
You have the whole road now. Every one of them talks to you and I am the only other one who can say that.

result.error: You already carry the Galaxy Rod.
You already carry the Yoon's Locked-In Rod.

They rise for a shine: a Golden Lure will raise one, a Luminous will do it slower, and nothing else on your boat will do it at all. Forty years I stood at the lip of that water with the wrong thing on my line.

result.error: The Dunkleosteus. Keep the shine on your line.

lines.text: First trophy up out of the Ancient Deep. In one piece. You actually *did* it.
Listen to me. Whatever you think you're holding, you're holding less than half of it.
There are five more down there. Five. And I need every last one of them landed.
Poor word, for a rival. Let's call it *want* and leave it there.
I have spent more of my life on that black water than I will ever tell you. Not once did it open for me. Not once.
So here's the new bet. The only one that ever mattered. You and me. All six.
I didn't come to this dock to fish, if you must know. I came to find someone who *could*.
Took longer than I'd have liked. Don't ask me why. Just fish.
